highlights.title: Not-looping alert now escalates over time
changes: Not-looping now escalates in six steps: warnings at 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100 minutes, then Critical at 120 minutes.
All escalation steps are scheduled up front so the Critical alarm still arrives if iOS suspends Trio.
Any successful automated loop clears the entire escalation ladder and restarts the schedule fresh.
Device alarm defaults changed so only Critical alarms play a sound by default; lower tiers are silent banners.

includedPullRequests.title: Adjust Not-Looping Alerts Escalation
includedPullRequests.body:
## Summary

Changes the not-looping alert from a single 20 min critical alarm into a six-step escalation scheme:

* Time-Sensitive at 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100 min
* Critical at 120 min
* All six are armed up front as OS notifications, so escalation still works if iOS ever suspends Trio
* Any successful loop retracts the full ladder and starts fresh

Each warning gets its own alert ID (`w1`…`w5`) because pending notifications with the same identifier replace each other rather than stack.

Also updates device alarm defaults:

* Critical defaults to sound on, using `high_chimes.caf`
* Time-Sensitive and Normal default to silent
* Decode fallback now follows the per-tier default
* Glucose alarm sound defaults are unchanged

Tests were updated for the new ladder and sound defaults, and the unused `AlertMuter.allowedDurations` was removed.

### Note

Existing persisted device alarm settings are left untouched, so current users keep their existing `playsSound` / `soundFilename` values. Moving them to the new defaults would need an explicit migration.

includedPullRequests.title: PATCH RELEASE Trio v1.0.1
includedPullRequests.body:
## What's Changed At A Glance

- **Three crashes fixed** – deleting a time segment in any therapy schedule, opening Target Behavior in settings, and a Home screen crash path
- **Charts line up again** – x-axis labels across the statistics and main charts, and the missing labels on Distribution (by day)
- **Black-Dot Omnipod 5** – Silence Pod message indicates if your current pod is a Black-Dot Omnipod 5 Pod that cannot be completely silenced
* Reworked Pod Keep Alive - default behavior is to use When Open mode; the other selections should not be required with *eager-connect* and will be removed soon in a future release
- **Libre 3 / 3+ alerts stop when you remove the sensor** – expiry alerts no longer keep firing after the CGM has been deleted
- **Dana connection fixes** – a connection callback race and a dose end-time bug
- **Updated translations** across Trio and its device drivers

minor codeowners fix
includedPullRequests.body:
A `/*` in the CODEOWNERS file only matches files directly in that folder and not subfolders. Fix the file so that the more-specific codeowner group is used for oref, ci, and translations instead of the global codeowner group.

This doesn't need to be expedited or anything, codeowners should be working now generally, but is a correctness fix.
